description: An upside-down classic three-circle Hidden Mickey is painted into the lower part of the moon in the large mural behind the gift shop's cash register. It blends into the moon's craters and shading, and the inverted orientation makes it easy to dismiss as more surface texture.

whereToLook.scene: Large space mural on the wall behind the cash register in the gift shop at the ride exit
whereToLook.exactSpot: Lower part of the moon. Look for three circles among the craters that form the classic shape, upside down.

bestTip: Scan the bottom half of the moon for a crater with two smaller craters hanging beneath it rather than above it.
funFacts: This mural hides three separate Hidden Mickeys. The other two are in the ground under Minnie Mouse's left foot and the thrusters behind the blue shuttle.

viewing.notes: The mural is behind the register counter, so you will be looking from the customer side. Wait for a gap between transactions for a clear view.
